photo.caption: An empty yeast tray at a supermarket in Odense on 17 March 2020. Following the announcement of a general lockdown, large-scale panic buying of several everyday products occurred.
photo.description: Empty yeast tray in supermarket in Odense, Denmark on March 17, 2020. Following prime minister Mette Frederiksen's announcement of a general lockdown, there was a widespread hoarding of yeast, despite yeast having a relatively short shelf-life. The shop in question was otherwise quite well-supplied; in particular, there was no shortage of toilet paper. See w:en:2020 coronavirus pandemic in Denmark for more information.
